BANG & OLUFSEN BEOSOUND, CARBON FIBER TRIM, BUCKINGHAMSHIRE GREEN PAINT, AND MORE!

OVERVIEW
The 2023 Aston Martin DBS 770 Ultimate marks the final chapter for one of the brand's most powerful and celebrated grand tourers. Created as the ultimate version of the DBS, the 770 Ultimate combines a hand-built V12 with sharper chassis tuning, exclusive styling, and a production run of just 300 units. Power comes from a 5.2-liter twin-turbocharged V12, producing a whopping 759 horsepower and 664 lb-ft of torque. Paired with a ZF 8-speed automatic transmission, the DBS 770 Ultimate sends power to the rear wheels through a mechanical limited-slip differential. It accelerates from 0-60 mph in just 3.2 seconds and reaches a top speed of 211 mph. The chassis received a series of upgrades to match the additional power. Steering calibration was sharpened, suspension tuning was revised, and the adaptive dampers were retuned for greater body control. Visually, the 770 Ultimate turns heads with ease. A redesigned front splitter, larger air intakes, and unique hood vents improve both airflow and cooling while giving the car a more aggressive appearance. Exposed carbon fiber appears throughout the exterior, while unique 21-inch wheels emphasize its exclusive status. Inside, the cabin combines handcrafted luxury with a more sporting character. Semi-aniline leather and Alcantara, carbon-fiber trim, and unique stitching create an interior worthy of a flagship GT. Bolstered seats provide additional support without sacrificing comfort, while the low seating position and driver-focused cockpit make the V12 feel much closer at hand. Every surface reinforces the sense that this is something more special than a standard DBS. The 2023 DBS 770 Ultimate is the closing chapter of an era for Aston Martin. With breathtaking performance, timeless British design, and true exclusivity, the 770 Ultimate sends the iconic DBS off exactly as it deserves.

Originally commissioned through a longtime Porsche specialist with more than two decades of experience at Porsche dealerships, stateside and abroad, this example was part of a special trio of Sport Classics intentionally configured to pay homage to the legendary 1973 Carrera RS communication color combinations. The three cars were configured in White/Red, White/Green, and White/Blue themes influenced by the illustrious RS period. This unit was the White/Green 911 and initially featured green-finished wheels prior to being later refinished by a subsequent owner.

Notably, White was not originally offered as a Paint to Sample option for the Sport Classic. However, after the vision and historical inspiration behind the project were presented directly to Porsche AG, approval was granted, making this one of the very few Sport Classics delivered in this specification.

Unit number 299 of just 1,250 examples produced worldwide, this Sport Classic shows only 3,XXX miles from new, displays a Clean CARFAX REPORT, and is finished in Paint to Sample White over a Heritage Design Interior in Black. Showcased on white-finished, 20 and 21-inch center-lock wheels featuring the famed Fuchs design alongside other exterior highlights, including a fixed carbon-fiber ducktail spoiler, Exclusive Manufaktur detailing on the front fenders, gold badging, a double-bubble carbon-fiber roof, and wide Turbo S-borrowed bodywork. Inside, its Heritage Design Interior in Black continues the retro-referenced theme with houndstooth-inspired Pepita inserts, Porsche crests embossed on the headrests and a numbered plaque mounted on the dashboard indicating its position within the limited production period.

As the widest-bodied 911 in the current model range, the Sport Classic not only features a muscularly assertive stance but also holds the title of the most powerful manual 911 offered on the market today.

The 911 Sport Classic is a true driver's car, meticulously blending heritage with modern performance in a format that distinctly sets it apart from the rest of the 911 lineup. It features a lightweight insulation package that sheds 5.1 lbs for a more visceral driving experience. Key body components, including the front hood, roof, and fixed ducktail rear spoiler, are crafted from carbon fiber to further reduce weight. The signature double-dome carbon fiber roof adds a defining visual and functional touch.

Powering the Sport Classic is a 3.7-liter twin-turbo flat-six that is responsible for delivering 543 hp and 442 lb-ft of torque exclusively to the rear wheels through a lovely 7-speed manual transmission with a 0-60 mph time of just 3.9 seconds and a top speed of 195 mph.

2023 PORSCHE 911 GT3
BLACK • FULL STEALTH PPF • PURE MOTORSPORT DNA

This is not an ordinary 911.
This stunning 2023 Porsche 911 GT3 is the ultimate expression of Porsche's motorsport heritage, combining an incredible naturally aspirated flat-six engine with razor-sharp handling, breathtaking aerodynamics, and the unmistakable presence of a GT3.
Finished in Black and protected by Full Stealth Paint Protection Film (PPF), this GT3 has an aggressive, sophisticated appearance while offering an additional layer of protection for the factory finish.

⭐ VEHICLE HIGHLIGHTS
  • 2023 Porsche 911 GT3
  • GT3 Coupe
  • VIN: WP0AC2A97PS270331
  • Stock #: PM25222
  • Black Exterior
  • Full Stealth Paint Protection Film (PPF)
  • Naturally Aspirated 4.0L Flat-Six
  • 502 Horsepower
  • 9,000 RPM Redline
  • Rear-Wheel Drive
  • Porsche GT3 Performance Engineering
  • Aggressive Aerodynamic Design
  • Large Fixed Rear Wing
  • Center-Lock Wheels
  • GT-Specific Suspension & Chassis Tuning
  • Performance-Focused Interior
  • Iconic GT3 Styling
THE HEART OF A GT3
At the center of this incredible Porsche is a 4.0-liter naturally aspirated flat-six, producing approximately 502 horsepower and capable of revving all the way to 9,000 RPM.
There is something special about a naturally aspirated Porsche GT3. The throttle response, linear power delivery, escalating exhaust note, and incredible high-RPM character create an experience that modern turbocharged sports cars simply cannot replicate.
This is an engine designed to be experienced, not simply measured.

️ BUILT WITH MOTORSPORT DNA
The GT3 isn't simply a faster 911—it is engineered with an entirely different philosophy.
From its sophisticated suspension and chassis tuning to its aggressive aerodynamic package and massive rear wing, every element is designed to deliver exceptional feedback and confidence behind the wheel.
The result is a Porsche that feels equally at home on a winding canyon road or a race track.

BLACK WITH FULL STEALTH PPF
The Black exterior gives this GT3 a timeless and menacing appearance, while the Full Stealth PPF adds an incredible satin-like finish and helps protect the underlying paint from road debris, rock chips, and everyday wear.
The combination creates a look that is both aggressive and exceptionally sophisticated.
And unlike a traditional matte paint finish, the stealth film can provide the visual impact of a satin finish while preserving and protecting the original paint underneath.

WHY THE GT3 IS DIFFERENT
Naturally aspirated. High-revving. Rear-wheel drive. Aerodynamically engineered.
The 911 GT3 has become one of the most sought-after modern performance cars because it delivers an experience that feels increasingly rare.
The steering is precise.
The chassis is incredibly communicative.
The engine begs to be revved.
The aero gives the car an unmistakable presence.
Every detail serves a purpose.

AN INCREDIBLE COLLECTOR-LEVEL PERFORMANCE CAR
The 992-generation GT3 represents one of Porsche's most celebrated modern 911s. Its combination of naturally aspirated performance, motorsport-derived engineering, aggressive styling, and everyday usability has made it a favorite among Porsche enthusiasts and collectors alike.
This particular example adds another level of desirability with its Black exterior and Full Stealth PPF.

Its twin-turbocharged inline-six delivers the kind of relentless, linear power delivery that's become an M-division signature, while a track-honed chassis and electronically controlled rear differential give drivers precise, confidence-inspiring control at the limit. Shoppers gravitate toward the M4 because it doesn't force a choice between comfort and capability. This Trans Am features a Blueprint 396 cubic inch V8 paired with a 4L80E automatic transmission and a Quick Performance 9-inch rear axle. Recently painted in a beautiful custom Red exterior, this example features a matching Red interior, with each body panel individually removed and painted to achieve a high-quality finish. This Trans Am has outstanding Pace Car heritage and was awarded 1st place in the Modified Class at the 2024 Trans Am Nationals. The glove box door is also signed by John Schinella at the 2024 Trans Am Nationals reflecting the original color intended by GM designer. Performance upgrades include a FiTech fuel injection system, an 850 CFM street/race carburetor, a triple-disc torque converter, a rebuilt front suspension with tubular control arms, an upgraded performance braking system, Borgeson power steering, performance leaf springs with CalTracs traction bars, and a performance exhaust system. Drive this one out of our showroom or have us assist with shipping it to you anywhere in the United States! Don't hesitate to call us with any questions or for more information. The 1981 Pontiac Trans Am was part of the second-generation Firebird that had become one of America's most recognizable performance cars. Pontiac's Trans Am had evolved throughout the 1970s, combining aggressive styling with the performance image that helped define the muscle car era. By 1981, the Trans Am featured the distinctive aerodynamic styling of the late second-generation cars, including its long hood, sculpted bodywork, and iconic rear spoiler. The 1981 model year was also notable as the final year of the second-generation Firebird, giving these cars an important place in Pontiac history. Trans Ams from this era remain highly sought after for their dramatic styling, performance heritage, and connection to the muscle car culture of the late 1970s and early 1980s. This 2020 Corvette Stingray represents a significant investment in performance and style. The 6.2L V8 engine paired with an 8-speed automatic transmission delivers responsive power while achieving 27 highway miles per gallon. With 25,916 miles, this vehicle is well-maintained and ready for the next owner who appreciates refined driving capabilities.

The 2LT Preferred Equipment Group establishes a foundation of premium comfort and convenience. GT2 bucket seats with two-tone leather and perforated inserts provide support for both driver and passenger. The sueded microfiber-wrapped steering wheel adds a tactile element to every drive, while heated and vented front seats ensure comfort across seasons. Eight-way power adjustments for both driver and passenger, combined with power lumbar controls, allow each occupant to find their ideal seating position.

Technology integration enhances both safety and driving engagement. The head-up display presents critical information directly in your line of sight, reducing the need to look away from the road. Rear and front HD cameras, combined with rear cross traffic alert and side blind zone alert, provide comprehensive visibility. The rear camera mirror offers an alternative view for maneuvering, while the performance data and video recorder captures track performance or memorable drives. Navigation, wireless device charging, and the Chevrolet Infotainment 3 Premium System with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto keep you connected seamlessly.

The body-color dual roof package distinguishes this Stingray distinctly. Both a body-color roof panel and transparent roof panel are included, allowing you to customize your driving experience. The roof panel storage pouch keeps essentials secure and accessible. The front lift adjustable height with memory adjusts automatically to your preferred clearance, protecting the vehicle during low-clearance passages.

Visual impact comes from the 19-inch front and 20-inch rear carbon flash-painted aluminum wheels with machined edges. The performance exhaust system adds five horsepower and torque while delivering an aggressive sound that varies with driver mode selection. Stainless-steel tips complete the refined appearance.

The Bose Performance Series Sound System with 14 speakers delivers audio quality that complements the vehicle's sophistication. The comprehensive safety suite includes electronic stability control, traction control, four-wheel independent suspension, dual front and side impact airbags, and a security system including an electrical theft deterrent and vehicle inclination and interior movement theft deterrent sensors.

This 2020 Corvette Stingray positions you for an ownership experience defined by performance, technology, and control. Visit our showroom to experience this vehicle firsthand and begin your next chapter behind the wheel.

Introducing the 2020 Chevrolet Corvette Stingray 2LT, a striking blue sports car that represents the pinnacle of American automotive performance and design.

This exceptional vehicle comes equipped with a comprehensive selection of premium features:

- 6.2L V8 Engine with 8-Speed Dual Clutch Transmission
- Z51 Performance Package with high-performance suspension and brakes
- Z51 Performance Suspension with Magnetic Selective Ride Control
- Performance Rear Axle Ratio with Electronic Limited-Slip Differential
- Performance Exhaust with Stainless-Steel Tips
- Z51 Performance Brakes with Bright Red-Painted Calipers
- Head-Up Display
- Heated & Ventilated Front Seats with GT1 Bucket Seats
- Heated Steering Wheel
- Performance Data & Video Recorder
- Rear Camera Mirror with HD Front & Rear Vision Cameras

- Bose Performance Series Sound System with 14 Speakers and SiriusXM Radio
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto Compatibility
- Wireless Charging for Devices

The Corvette delivers responsive performance with a 6.2L V8 engine achieving 15 MPG city and 27 MPG highway. Its low mileage of 8,811 miles demonstrates exceptional care and minimal use, presenting the opportunity to own a virtually new performance machine.

This vehicle has been certified, ensuring it meets rigorous quality standards and providing you with confidence in your purchase. A certified vehicle represents our commitment to delivering only the finest examples to our customers, backed by thorough inspection and verification of its condition and history.

The Z51 Performance Package elevates every driving experience with precision engineering throughout. Front and rear performance suspension components work seamlessly with the electronic limited-slip differential and high-performance braking system to deliver controlled power delivery. The performance exhaust system enhances both capability and character, while the heavy-duty cooling system ensures reliability even under demanding conditions.

Inside, the sophisticated cabin combines luxury with functionality. The GT1 bucket seats offer superior support wrapped in leather with perforated inserts, while the heated and ventilated seating ensures comfort in any season. The heated steering wheel, power-adjustable lumbar support, and memory settings allow you to personalize your driving position. The rear camera mirror and HD vision cameras provide exceptional visibility, complemented by rear cross traffic alert for enhanced safety awareness.

This 2020 Corvette Stingray 2LT represents a rare opportunity to acquire a low-mileage, performance-ready machine that combines engineering excellence with refined luxury. We invite you to visit our showroom to experience this vehicle firsthand and explore ownership of an iconic American sports car.

description: 2013 Ford Mustang Shelby GT500 Coupe For Sale in "Black!" Only 6K Miles Stripe Delete Completely Stock WE FINANCE There are GT500s—and then there are the examples collectors wait for. This 2013 Ford Mustang Shelby GT500 Coupe is finished in sinister Black with the rare factory Stripe Delete , shows an incredible 6,000 original miles , and was ordered with virtually every option you could want: SVT Performance Package, SVT Track Package, Recaro seats, Electronics Package with Navigation, and Shaker Pro Audio. It carries a Clean Carfax with no accident history. And perhaps most importantly for a car like this: ZERO modifications. No pulley. No tune. No intake. No exhaust. No aftermarket wheels. Six thousand miles later, this GT500 remains exactly what Ford and SVT intended it to be. The 2013 GT500 The 2013 wasn't simply another model-year update. Ford's SVT engineers essentially reworked the GT500 around a new supercharged 5.8L V8 producing 662 horsepower and 631 lb-ft of torque , backed by a Tremec six-speed manual and carbon-fiber driveshaft. The development targets were outrageous: more than 650 horsepower, more than 600 lb-ft of torque, and a top speed exceeding 200 mph. They achieved all three. At the time, Ford called its 5.8L the most powerful production V8 in the world. But history has given the 2013 another layer of significance. Carroll Shelby himself was involved in its development. Even in his late 80s, Shelby participated in engineering validation, spending time behind the wheel and providing feedback to Ford's SVT engineers. He passed away in May 2012, shortly before the 2013 GT500 reached customers, making this the final production Mustang program to receive his personal involvement. That history matters more today than it did when these cars were simply sitting on showroom floors. Stripe Delete Sometimes what isn't there makes the car. This GT500 was ordered in Black without the traditional Shelby racing stripes , giving it an unusually clean and understated appearance. No contrasting stripes. No visual noise. Just Black paint, aggressive GT500 bodywork, and the unmistakable proportions of the final S197 Shelby. For a 662-horsepower Mustang, it's remarkably subtle. Factory Options & Equipment Include: Black Exterior Factory Stripe Delete Supercharged 5.8L DOHC V8 662 Horsepower / 631 lb-ft of Torque Tremec TR-6060 6-Speed Manual Transmission Carbon-Fiber Driveshaft SVT Performance Package Torsen Limited-Slip Differential SVT-Designed Bilstein Electronic Adjustable Dampers SVT Track Package Additional Engine, Differential & Transmission Cooling Recaro Sport Seats Electronics Package with Navigation Shaker Pro Premium Audio System Brembo Performance Braking System Launch Control Only 6,000 Original Miles Clean Carfax - No Accident History Completely Stock & Unmodified The Right Options Low mileage is great. Low mileage with the right factory equipment is considerably better. The SVT Performance Package gave the GT500 its electronically adjustable Bilstein dampers and Torsen limited-slip differential , while the Track Package added additional cooling hardware designed for sustained high-performance use. Then add the Recaros. Navigation. Shaker Pro. Stripe Delete. This wasn't a base GT500 that simply survived with low mileage. It was ordered right from the beginning. They Were Almost Too Easy To Modify This is where finding one like this becomes increasingly difficult. The 5.8L GT500 responded incredibly well to modifications, and it didn't take long before these cars were receiving smaller pulleys, tunes, cold-air intakes, exhaust systems, aftermarket wheels, suspension changes, and increasingly serious power upgrades. Again—there's nothing wrong with a properly modified GT500. But you can only be factory-original once. This car has covered just 6,000 miles , and nobody gave in to the temptation. No chasing another 100 horsepower. No changing the stance. No trying to improve what SVT already built. It survived. One Of The Important Ones The GT500 name has returned in newer, faster, and increasingly sophisticated forms. But the 2013 occupies a very particular place in Mustang history. 662 horsepower. 631 lb-ft. Six-speed manual. Rear-wheel drive. Carbon-fiber driveshaft. 200+ mph capability. And Carroll Shelby's fingerprints still on the program. There are plenty of GT500s in the world. Finding a 6,000-mile 2013 , completely stock, accident-free, factory stripe-delete, and equipped with SVT Performance, SVT Track, Recaros, Navigation, and Shaker Pro is a very different proposition. This isn't simply a fast used Mustang anymore. It's an exceptionally preserved example of one of the most important modern Shelby Mustangs —and exactly the kind of specification collectors are beginning to recognize. TEXAS HOT RIDES 1833 N. I35E Carrollton, Texas 75006 MONDAY-FRIDAY 10am-6pm SATURDAY 10am-4pm (Appointment Recommended) CALL OR TEXT US AT 214-244-2956 For the Shelby collector who has been waiting for the right one, this checks the boxes that cannot be added later: the history, the factory specification, the originality, and only 6,000 miles. There will always be another GT500 for sale. Finding another one preserved like this is a very different conversation.

Safety and Security
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.
  • Lane departure prevention - Keep it between the lines. It only takes a moment of inattention for your vehicle to drift. With lane departure prevention, your vehicle takes corrective action to help you avoid unintentionally moving out of your lane. Lane departure prevention is an extra level of safety for you and those around you.
Technology and Telematics

VIN: ZAM45VLA6J0263806
Mileage: Only 15,440 Miles

Exceptionally Low Mileage. No Accidents Reported to CARFAX. Carbon Fiber Exterior & Interior. Two Keys. Truly Exceptional Condition.

There are clean Maserati GranTurismos.

And then there are cars like this.

With only 15,440 original miles, this 2018 Maserati GranTurismo Sport has been driven extraordinarily little and preserved in a condition that is becoming increasingly difficult to find.

The previous owner simply did not drive the car very much. It was kept indoors, carefully preserved, and today the condition reflects exactly that.

The interior still has the feel and even the unmistakable scent of a much newer car.

Paint, trim, leather, controls, carbon fiber and overall presentation are exceptionally well preserved.

This is not simply a low-mileage GranTurismo.

This is a genuine mint-condition example.

Why This GranTurismo Is Special?

The GranTurismo has always been one of Maserati s most beautiful modern designs, but finding a late-production example with this mileage and condition is another story entirely.

This car has traveled only 15,440 miles in approximately eight years.

CARFAX reports no accidents or damage, no structural damage, no airbag deployment and no odometer issues. It also shows an extensive service history, including repeated servicing through Maserati dealerships.

Most importantly, the physical condition backs up the mileage.

The cabin is exceptionally fresh, the exterior presents beautifully, and the car has clearly avoided the normal wear associated with most GranTurismos now on the market.

It also comes equipped with:

Exterior Carbon Fiber

Interior Carbon Fiber Trim

Two Keys

combined with an exceptionally desirable low-mileage specification.

The Last of a Special Era

Under the hood is the naturally aspirated 4.7-liter V8, delivering the sound, throttle response and character that made the GranTurismo one of the most emotional Italian grand tourers of its generation.

There is no turbocharger trying to imitate the experience.

No artificial soundtrack required.

Just a naturally aspirated Italian V8, rear-wheel drive and one of the most recognizable exhaust notes of the modern Maserati era.

As manufacturers continue moving toward smaller turbocharged engines and electrification, cars like the GranTurismo increasingly represent a type of driving experience that simply will not be produced again in the same way.

Extremely Rare Condition for Its Age

A GranTurismo You Have to See in Person

Mileage tells part of the story.

Condition tells the rest.

At only 15,440 miles, this GranTurismo has experienced a fraction of the use normally seen on an eight-year-old performance car.

Open the door and that becomes immediately apparent.

The leather, carbon fiber, controls and overall cabin presentation have the preserved feel of a car that was simply never used as a daily driver.

Finding another 2018 GranTurismo is easy.

Finding another one with this mileage, this condition, this history and this level of preservation is considerably harder.

For the buyer who has been waiting for the right GranTurismo rather than simply the cheapest one available, this is the example worth seeing.

Experience the thrill of driving a 2021 Dodge Challenger R/T Scat Pack Coupe, a powerful and stylish vehicle that combines muscle car performance with modern technology. With a sleek Gray exterior and a comfortable Black interior, this used Challenger offers an impressive 6.4-liter V8 engine producing up to 485 horsepower at 6100 RPM and 475 lb-ft of torque at 4100 RPM. It features an 8-speed automatic transmission and rear-wheel drive, making every drive exhilarating. This coupe has traveled 64,844 miles and is equipped with features like Apple CarPlay, Bluetooth, and satellite radio readiness, ensuring your connectivity on the go. The vehicle also offers a premium audio system, heated seats, keyless entry, push start, and a WiFi hotspot, providing both convenience and entertainment for drivers and passengers alike.

Designed for safety and security, this Challenger is equipped with premium Brembo brakes for reliable stopping power, driver knee airbags, and rear parking sensors to assist with parking. Dual front active head restraints, four-wheel ABS, emergency braking preparation, auto-locking power door locks, and brake drying contribute to a secure driving experience. Whether you're cruising or pushing the limits, these features help keep you protected on the road.

2021 Dodge Challenger Safety and Security Features

This vehicle boasts advanced safety features including Brembo brakes for superior stopping power, driver knee airbags for added protection, and rear parking sensors to aid in maneuvering. Dual front active head restraints enhance occupant safety, while four-wheel ABS and emergency braking preparation add confidence during emergency stops. Auto-locking power door locks and brake drying systems further improve security and safety in various conditions.

2021 Dodge Challenger Entertainment and Technology Features

Stay connected and entertained with SiriusXM Guardian app compatibility, enabling remote engine start and cabin preconditioning. Hands-free voice-operated phone calls and radio ensure safe communication while driving. The Challenger's HD radio and an 8.4-inch touchscreen display provide crisp audio and easy access to your favorite media. Electronic messaging assistance, both read and voice-operated, complements the infotainment system, which delivers 276 watts of sound for an immersive experience.

2021 Dodge Challenger Performance Features

This Challenger’s performance is accentuated by a performance exhaust system that delivers an aggressive sound, complemented by a rear limited slip differential for enhanced traction. Its tuned sport suspension ensures sharp handling and ride stability, making it a true muscle car ready for spirited driving and everyday use.
